Solution: Factors of 21: 1, 3, 7, 21; Factors of 28: 1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 28. Common factors: 1, 7. The greatest is 7.

Question Choices: You have 24 chocolates and 40 candies. You want to pack them into identical party bags so that each bag has the same number of chocolates and the same number of candies with no items left over. What is the greatest number of party bags you can make?
Hints: List common positive factors; choose the greatest one.
Solution: Factors of 24: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24; Factors of 40: 1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 10, 20, 40. Common factors: 1, 2, 4, 8. The greatest is 8. Make 8 identical groups, each with 3 of the first item and 5 of the second item. Check: 8×3=24 and 8×5=40.
